audit.why: EVEN 6/10 at 53.67% over 1539 games holds — Riven owns levels 1-2, Fiora owns Level 6, and everything else is execution.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet, the mirror and this page's own text: Level 1 was Skill though early calls the auto-weave window 'genuinely yours', Level 3 was Riven though whys[2] calls it a pure execution check, Level 6 was Skill though whys[4] says a full R duel goes her way, and first item and two items were Riven though whys[6] calls them level ground.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Riven, Riven, Skill, Skill, Fiora, Skill, Skill] and the mirror audit has already shipped exactly those flips (win[0]=Riven, win[2]=Skill, win[4]=Fiora, win[5]=Skill, win[6]=Skill).
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as matched full/content pairs with the phases whys rewritten to justify them.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] states 'your E shield does not absorb vital procs' and mid describes 'her true damage through your E shield'. wants.foe[1] calls vital damage 'percent-max-HP true damage'.
audit.why: Shields absorb damage of every type, true damage included — Valor is not bypassed by a vital hit, and telling a Riven player otherwise removes the one cooldown that survives her all-in. The kit also puts trueDamage only on Grand Challenge, not on Duelist's Dance, so the vital damage type is not something this data supports asserting at all. What Riot's text does say is that a vital hit heals Fiora and speeds her up, and that Lunge applies on-hit effects.
audit.corrected: Shield claim reversed in whys[4] and mid; wants.foe[1] restated around vital healing and Lunge's on-hit application, with no damage-type claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] and mid both state Riposte is 'roughly 16 seconds' at early ranks.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16 — 24 seconds at rank 1, and 16 only when maxed. The page understates the single most important window in the lane by eight seconds, which is the difference between a free all-in and walking into a parry.
audit.corrected: Both restated with 24s at rank 1 falling to 16s when maxed. Grand Challenge's 110s at rank 1 added to phases[4].why.

audit.why: The page already states the important quirk correctly: Riposte only parries abilities, so basic attacks are safe into it — and if she parries an immobilising effect, the return stab stuns instead of slowing, which is exactly why Ki Burst into a held Riposte loses the trade.
audit.corrected: No change needed; the existing bait-first advice is sound.

edits.before: Your Q resets win level 1 if you weave autos between casts. Identify how Fiora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Riposte only answers abilities, so your auto-weave is free at Level 1 — proc Runic Blade and take the CS lead before her vitals cycle.

edits.after: She now holds Riposte specifically for your Ki Burst — the trade goes to whoever baits the parry first, and nothing else.

edits.after: Your first item buys enough HP to finish the chain, not to win the long duel.

edits.before: Her Riposte cooldown (~16s early) is the only timer that matters here — trade when it is down, disengage when she is sitting on it, and avoid walking onto active vitals.
edits.after: Riposte is 24 seconds at rank 1 and only reaches 16 when maxed — that whole window is yours: trade the moment it is spent, give nothing while she sits on it, and never walk onto a live vital.

edits.before: Grand Challenge simultaneously activates four vitals and accelerates her true-damage throughput; your E shield does not absorb vital procs, so a full R duel below 60% HP goes her way.
edits.after: Grand Challenge lights all four vitals at once and heals her and nearby allies if she completes them — Valor's shield does absorb vital damage, but a fresh R duel below 60% HP still goes her way.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a discipline check. Fiora's Riposte is a roughly 16-second cooldown at early ranks — track it. If you land Ki Burst without getting Riposted you win the trade convincingly; if she parries it she gets a stun on you and the vital proc, and you lose. Never auto-attack a vital she is actively standing on top of; she will Q to the next one. At Level 6 the math shifts: Grand Challenge creates four active vitals at once, and her true damage through your E shield accelerates dramatically. Force fights on your terms with Wind Slash available — your execute range lets you cash the all-in from a distance she cannot Riposte.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a discipline check. Riposte is 24 seconds at rank 1 and still 16 when maxed — track it. If you land Ki Burst without getting Riposted you win the trade convincingly; if she parries it, that return stab stuns you instead of slowing, and you lose. Never auto a vital she is standing on; she will Lunge to the next one. At Level 6 the math shifts: Grand Challenge lights four vitals at once and heals her when she finishes them. Force fights with Wind Slash up — its range cashes the all-in from outside anything she can parry.

edits.before: Cycle vitals with Q dashes between trades to stack passive procs and let percent-max-HP true damage whittle through your shield
edits.after: Cycle vitals with Lunge between trades — it applies on-hit effects, and every vital she hits heals her and speeds her up

notes: Two shield errors corrected: Valor absorbs vital damage (shields are not bypassed), and the 'true damage' label on vitals is not supported by the kit — trueDamage sits on Grand Challenge only, so no damage-type claim was written. Riposte's cooldown was understated as ~16s in two places; it is 24s at rank 1. Chart flips match what the mirror already shipped. Two items left as Skill per the mirror even though carryRating reads 10/10.
